name: A Day's Travel
effect: You and your _Spirit_ gain _Fatigue_ at the end of the day. If you do not use any Spiritcraft and do not manifest your Spirit, they do not gain _Fatigue_. You may remove a _Fatigue_ you would take by spending [-].
special: If you have a _Heavy Load_, take an additional _Fatigue_.

name: Time Passes
effect: Time passes; if any characters have not taken a _Travel Action_ this phase, they may take it now. If they did not _Detour_ during this _Phase_, mark one Progress.

name: Comfortable Camp
effect: You find a fortuitous camp site; if you wish, you may decide to _Make Camp_. If you do, _Time Passes_.

name: Lost
effect: At the end of the day, roll a d6, plus an additional d6 for every [-] placed on this. If the highest die rolled is less than the Navigation check for this Leg, lose progress at the end of the day.
